result.summary: The image depicts a wide roadway bordering a park-like area with a complete absence of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, marked crossings, or traffic control devices, forcing pedestrians to share space with vehicles or navigate unpaved surfaces.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Walkway
hazards.description: No sidewalks are present, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: A line of parked cars blocks sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the road from the park area.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked crossings or signage, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing to the park.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one side of the road to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility around parked cars.

result.summary: The street features a continuous sidewalk on the right side and mature trees, but lacks marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. Parked vehicles along both curbs create significant visual obstructions for anyone attempting to cross the two-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross at unmarked locations without clear priority.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking blocks sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a wide sidewalk on one side and a park area on the other. While a sidewalk is present, the environment lacks basic crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signage at the visible intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing point for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner and street trees may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sidewalk trip hazards
hazards.description: Cracks and vegetation growth in the sidewalk pavement create uneven surfaces.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps at the intersection to provide accessible transitions between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide intersection with faded crosswalk markings and significant crossing distances. While sidewalks and street lighting are present, the lack of high-visibility pedestrian infrastructure and the scale of the roadway suggest a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are heavily worn and lack high visibility, reducing driver awareness of the crossing zone.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
